# eBrowser

> llms.txt for the eBrowser repository (embeddedos-org/eBrowser).
> Status: privacy-first browser with a custom rendering engine,
> version 2.0.2 (per the `project()` declaration in CMakeLists.txt).
> The committed CycloneDX SBOM is `sbom/ebrowser-2.0.2.cdx.json`,
> drift-checked in Nightly against that version.

eBrowser is EmbeddedOS's privacy-first browser: a custom
rendering engine with a privacy engine whose invariants are
documented as developer contracts, a C11 codebase, and a
security posture maintained under the CRA regime — a committed
SBOM whose version is checked against the build's declared
version every night, so the artifact inventory cannot silently
drift from the code.

## Docs

- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) — engine structure and components
- [Platform guide](docs/platform-guide.md) — supported platforms and bring-up
- [Privacy invariants](docs/privacy-invariants.md) — the privacy engine's developer contracts (`src/privacy/`)
- [Security advisory v2.0.0](docs/security-advisory-v2.0.0.md) — the v2.0.0 advisory record

## Machine-readable

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) — this corpus concatenated as one document
- `sbom/ebrowser-2.0.2.cdx.json` — the committed CycloneDX SBOM (in the repo, under `sbom/`)
